title: Uma-Maheshwar (in round)
brief_description: A highly ornamented sculpture of Uma-Maheshwar in alingana posture.
detailed_description: A highly ornamented sculpture of Uma-Maheshwar in alingana posture wearing jatha mukutha with depiction of elaborate, ornamental prabhavali behind their heads. Right hand of Mahesh is in abhayamudra and the left arm is embracing Uma on her shoulder. Uma is depicted with four hands. One right arm is broken and the other is embracing Mahesh. In the left hand she is holding a lotus (only the stem is visible) and in the other hand she is holding a mirror. Both the deities are adorned with elaborate ornamentation.
